items.title: Voluntary data submission pilot to advance innovative alternatives to animal testing
items.summary: EMA has launched a new voluntary data submission (VDS) pilot to facilitate the sharing of data generated using New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). These innovative methods have…

items.title: Eli Lilly escalates oral SERD battle with FDA approval for Inluriyo, Verzenio combo
items.summary: With longer progression-free survival, Jake Van Naarden, president of Lilly Oncology, told Fierce he expects most patients to choose the combination over oral SERD monotherapy.

items.title: FDA approves Ultragenyx’s gene therapy Fayuvi for rare neurodegenerative disorder
items.summary: Ultragenyx scored a belated regulatory win with FDA approval for a first-in-disease gene therapy, giving the company a boost after a previous regulatory rejection and a recent late-stage setback.

items.title: FDA drops warning letter on Bausch & Lomb, citing contamination concerns
items.summary: The FDA issued a warning letter to Bausch & Lomb over contamination concerns at its Tampa, Florida, facility that produces prescription and over-the-counter eye medications.

items.title: New EU supply chain to end Visudyne shortage

items.title: After one failed acquisition attempt, Lisata finds lifeline in Marea merger
items.summary: After a failed merger that led to massive layoffs and a lawsuit, solid tumor biotech Lisata Therapeutics has found a new future through a merger with cardio specialist Marea Therapeutics.

items.title: Artelo’s ex-AstraZeneca cannabinoid agonist holds its own against GLP-1 drug semaglutide in obese mice
items.summary: Artelo Biosciences’ oral dual cannabinoid agonist showed weight loss comparable to the GLP-1 semaglutide in obese mice.

items.title: Medtronic earns FDA clearance for LigaSure use with its Hugo robotic system
items.summary: The FDA has cleared Medtronic’s LigaSure RAS Maryland jaw vessel sealer-divider to be used in combination with the device maker’s Hugo robotic-assisted surgery system.

items.title: FDA clears Aptitude’s latest Metrix molecular dx to test for COVID
items.summary: The FDA granted Aptitude its first 510(k) clearance for the next-generation Metrix COVID diagnostic that features three-times greater sensitivity with 30% faster results that its original emergency use authorized test.

items.title: Xenon pauses phase 3 depression trials after psychosis events
items.summary: The company has voluntarily stopped enrolling new patients in the studies in response to reports of mostly mild or moderate adverse events.

items.title: North Immunology goes public via reverse merger as eczema drug heads toward clinic
items.summary: North Immunology has decided its path to taking an atopic dermatitis drug into the clinic involves going public via a reverse merger.

items.title: Longeveron’s phase 2b stem cell flop spurs cost cutting, exploration of ‘all options’
items.summary: A phase 2b study of Longeveron’s stem cell therapy in a pediatric heart disease has missed its primary endpoint, prompting the cash-strapped biotech to “review all options” for the business.

items.title: Sling reels in $123M series C to fund oral Tepezza rival through phase 3 trial
items.summary: Sling Therapeutics has closed a $123 million series C round to advance its oral therapy for thyroid eye disease through a phase 3 trial and hopefully on to commercialization.

items.title: Bayer’s Kerendia secures FDA nod as first drug in 30 years for Type 1 diabetes-associated kidney disease
items.summary: The heart and kidney med earned the first FDA nod in three decades for adults with chronic kidney disease associated with type 1 diabetes.

items.title: Roche’s Lunsumio delivers positive confirmatory trial readout in follicular lymphoma
items.summary: Roche’s T-cell engager portfolio has notched another milestone, as a phase 3 trial of the company’s Lunsumio met its primary endpoint in earlier-line follicular lymphoma.

items.title: Vera’s strong phase 3 IgAN data for Trutakna intensify kidney disease rivalry
items.summary: New phase 3 data show Vera Therapeutics’ Trutakna successfully stabilizes kidney function in IgA nephropathy patients, mirroring an earlier clinical success from Otsuka’s Voyxact and heating up competition in a rapidly evolving market race.

items.title: BMS, Ono take Amgen to task as FDA's Opdivo biosimilar decision looms
items.summary: As Amgen advances its bid to join the first wave of biosimilars to Bristol Myer Squibb and Ono’s oncology mega-blockbuster Opdivo, the originator drug’s partners are not taking the challenge lying down.

items.title: Novartis pays Sironax $125M to acquire platform for crossing the blood-brain barrier
items.summary: Novartis is paying Sironax $125 million to take up its option on a brain delivery platform, gaining control of technology for getting large molecules to targets in the central nervous system.

items.title: CEO O’Day tells Fierce how Gilead’s cancer, inflammation expansion has reached ‘critical mass’
items.summary: Following a steady stream of acquisitions that culminated in three biotech buyouts earlier this year, Gilead has now reached “critical mass” in its efforts to diversify into oncology and inflammation, CEO Daniel O’Day told Fierce.

items.title: Ex-PHM CEO Andrea Palmer takes top job at Assembled Intelligence
items.summary: Former Publicis Health Media CEO Andrea Palmer has revealed her next post. The executive has taken the CEO position at Assembled Intelligence, the agency that Minds + Assembly launched last year to integrate its flurry of acquisitions.

items.title: Refreshed Novo corrals 3 new early-stage obesity drugs from Kallyope
items.summary: New-look Novo is digging deeper into its metabolic roots with three new obesity programs purchased from New York biotech Kallyope.

items.title: Inside the growing world of biopharma prediction markets
items.summary: In this episode of “The Top Line,” we explore the growing space of biopharma prediction markets, how they work and the risks they create around insider information and clinical trial integrity.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Legend poaches Novartis vet to boost commercial potential
items.summary: After former Legend Biotech CEO Ying Huang, Ph.D., left the company suddenly in July, Legend has found its permanent CEO, poaching Novartis veteran Ingrid Zhang as the CAR-T specialist eyes its next phase of growth.

items.title: BMS dumps $100M Orum degrader-antibody conjugate after glimpsing phase 1 data
items.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb has axed the degrader-antibody conjugate it bought from Orum Therapeutics for $100 million, walking away from the asset after seeing phase 1 data.

items.title: Inflammation biotech Electra charges up with $350M from upsized IPO
items.summary: Electra Therapeutics is the latest biotech to overshoot its own IPO expectations this year, with the inflammation-focused company bringing in $350 million from this morning’s Nasdaq listing.

items.title: ARPA-H launches SPECTRA program, new autism research initiative
items.summary: Researchers will create an end-to-end system to identify ASD risk factors, connect patients to appropriate interventions and accelerate clinical research for new therapies.

items.title: Goa Therapeutics launches with ‘immeasurably huge’ vision of creating Narcan for alcohol
items.summary: A new biotech has sprung out of stealth with a bold vision to develop the “greatest therapeutic of all time”—a drug that can quickly sober up people who have had too much to drink.

items.title: Rare EGFR mutation increases lung cancer risk 62 times in never smokers
items.summary: A rare inherited germline mutation was found to increase risk for lung cancer by 25 times, while smoking only increased risk by 4 times.

items.title: DPHARM: How to address the clinical trial enrollment crisis?
items.summary: Clinical trials are facing an enrollment crisis. Around 80% of trials don’t meet their enrollment timelines, and fewer than 5% of eligible adult cancer patients participate in trials.

items.title: 'Still a bull': Novo's CEO on honoring heritage and planning for the future amid corporate rebrand
items.summary: Novo CEO Mike Doustdar—tapped to breathe new life into the Danish drugmaker last year after losing GLP-1 marketing ground to chief rival Eli Lilly—isn’t one to make changes for the sake of change.

items.title: Roche signs $1B deal with Dualitas to pair up on big bispecific screening drive
items.summary: Roche is paying Dualitas Therapeutics $36.5 million upfront to screen over 300,000 novel bispecific combinations in search of new treatments for immunology and inflammation diseases.

items.title: SK pens $315M pact with fellow South Korean company for Parkinson’s prospect
items.summary: SK Biopharmaceuticals has added a second preclinical Parkinson’s disease therapy to its pipeline courtesy of a $314.8 million biobucks deal with a fellow South Korean drug developer.

items.title: Novo explores macrocycles’ potential in $1.4B cardiometabolic pact with Danish biotech
items.summary: Novo’s race to rejuvenate its cardiometabolic portfolio has seen the rebranded Danish pharma pen a $1.4 billion biobucks pact with oral macrocycle drug start-up Orbis Medicines.

items.title: Novartis ends ALS program after phase 2 flop, adding to R&D woes
items.summary: Novartis has extended its losing streak, stopping an amyotrophic lateral sclerosis program after flunking a phase 2 trial.

items.title: FDA launches pilot program to speed up sluggish phase 1 trials
items.summary: After teasing a new initiative to speed up early-stage clinical trials over the summer, the FDA today opened a pilot program for an expedited investigational new drug (IND) application process that the agency hopes will put U.S. phase 1 trials on par with those in China and Australia.

items.title: Clinical trials reach a new automation inflection point
items.summary: As trial complexity grows, agentic AI is emerging as a new model for connecting workflows and accelerating execution.

items.title: Europe's CHMP endorses slew of new medicines, including new offerings from Novo and AZ
items.summary: The CHMP recommendation for Novo's next gen hemophilia A treatment was one of several noteworthy endorsements made by the EU agency this week.
